overview: Port Orleans French Quarter is the smallest Moderate resort, styled after New Orleans with wrought-iron balconies and gas-style lamps. It feels quiet and easy to get around.
suits: Couples and small families who want a calm, compact Moderate resort.
rooms: Standard rooms sleep four, and some royal-themed rooms sleep five. Most rooms are a short walk from the main building.
pools: Doubloon Lagoon has a sea-serpent waterslide and a playful Mardi Gras feel.
dining: Sassagoula Floatworks & Food Factory is the quick-service spot, famous for its beignets. For a sit-down meal, walk or take the boat to Riverside next door.
gettingAround: Buses go to every park, and a boat goes to Disney Springs.
cons: Only one food court on site
Fewer rooms means it can book up early
tips: Try the beignets at least once.
Take the boat to Disney Springs for dinner and shopping.
bestFor: Couples and small families who want a quiet Moderate resort.
